build_sparql.question: What are the publication types in dblp?
build_sparql.sparql:
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?type (COUNT(?type) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?subject rdf:type dblp:Publication .
  ?subject rdf:type ?type .
  FILTER( ?type != dblp:Publication )
}
GROUP BY ?type
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

build_sparql.question: How many authors does the paper entitled NFDI4DS Gateway and Portal have?
How many authors wrote the paper NFDI4DS Gateway and Portal?
In which venue was 'Bridge-Generate: Scholarly Hybrid Question Answering' published?
build_sparql.sparql:
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT * WHERE {
  ?publication dblp:title ?title .
  FILTER CONTAINS (?title, "Bridge-Generate: Scholarly Hybrid Question Answering") .
  ?publication dblp:publishedInStream ?venue .
  ?venue rdfs:label ?venue_name .
  OPTIONAL { ?publication dblp:yearOfPublication ?year } .
}

build_sparql.question: What are the papers written by David Sena Oliveira?

build_sparql.question: What are the most cited publications with title keyword 'database'?
build_sparql.sparql:
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
PREFIX cito: <http://purl.org/spar/cito/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?publ ?label (COUNT(?citation) as ?cites) WHERE {
  ?publ rdf:type dblp:Publication .
  ?publ dblp:title ?title .
  FILTER CONTAINS(?title, "database") .
  ?publ dblp:omid ?omid .
  ?publ rdfs:label ?label .
  ?citation rdf:type cito:Citation .
  ?citation cito:hasCitedEntity ?omid .
}
GROUP BY ?publ ?label 
ORDER BY DESC(?cites)
LIMIT 10

build_sparql.question: On average, how many research papers does Hannah Bast publish each year?
What is Hannah Bast's yearly publication count?
build_sparql.sparql:
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?countPerYear) WHERE 
{
   ?author dblp:creatorName ?author_name .
   FILTER CONTAINS( ?author_name, "Hannah Bast" )
   ?paper dblp:authoredBy ?author . 
   ?paper dblp:yearOfPublication ?year .
}
GROUP BY ?year
ORDER BY DESC(?year)

build_sparql.question: Give me doctoral students in dblp having published in the Semantic Web journal?
build_sparql.sparql:
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
SELECT ?student ?student_label ?advisor WHERE {
  ?student rdf:type dblp:Person .
  ?student rdfs:label ?student_label .
  ?student dblp:wikidata ?student_q .
  ?publ dblp:publishedInStream <https://dblp.org/streams/journals/semweb> .
  ?publ dblp:authoredBy ?student .
  SERVICE <https://query.wikidata.org/sparql> {
    ?student_q wdt:P2456 [] .
	?student_q wdt:P31 wd:Q5 .
    ?student_q wdt:P184 ?advisor_q .
    ?advisor_q rdfs:label ?advisor .
    FILTER(LANG(?advisor) = 'en')
  }
}
GROUP BY ?student ?student_label ?advisor
LIMIT 10

build_sparql.question: What is the number of theses in dblp by school?
build_sparql.sparql:
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?school (COUNT(DISTINCT ?thesis) as ?count) WHERE {
  ?thesis rdf:type dblp:Book .
  ?thesis dblp:thesisAcceptedBySchool ?school .
}
GROUP BY ?school 
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

build_sparql.question: Who are the highly cited coauthors of Hannah Bast?
build_sparql.sparql:
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
PREFIX cito: <http://purl.org/spar/cito/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?name ?affiliation (COUNT(DISTINCT ?cite) as ?cites) (?coauthor as ?dblp) (SAMPLE(?orcids) as ?orcid) WHERE {
  ?author dblp:creatorName ?author_name .
  FILTER CONTAINS( ?author_name, "Hannah Bast" )
  ?copubl dblp:authoredBy ?author .
  ?copubl dblp:authoredBy ?coauthor .
  FILTER ( ?author != ?coauthor ) .
  ?coauthor rdfs:label ?name .
  OPTIONAL { ?coauthor dblp:orcid ?orcids . }
  OPTIONAL { ?coauthor dblp:primaryAffiliation ?affiliation . }
  ?publ dblp:authoredBy ?coauthor .
  ?publ dblp:omid ?omid .
  ?cite cito:hasCitedEntity ?omid .
}
GROUP BY ?name ?affiliation ?coauthor
ORDER BY DESC(?cites)
LIMIT 10

build_sparql.question: What are the venues with largest community overlap with Transactions on Graph Data and Knowledge (TGDK)?
build_sparql.sparql:
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?venue (?other_stream as ?dblp) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?creator) as ?community_overlap) WHERE {
  ?stream rdf:type dblp:Stream .
  ?stream rdfs:label ?stream_label .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(?stream_label, "Transactions on Graph Data and Knowledge (TGDK)"))
  ?publ dblp:publishedInStream ?stream .
  ?publ dblp:createdBy ?creator .
  MINUS { ?creator rdf:type dblp:AmbiguousCreator . }
  ?other_publ dblp:createdBy ?creator .
  FILTER (?other_publ != ?publ ) .
  ?other_publ dblp:publishedInStream ?other_stream .
  FILTER (?other_stream != ?stream ) .
  ?other_stream rdfs:label ?venue .
}
GROUP BY ?venue ?other_stream 
ORDER BY DESC(?community_overlap) 
LIMIT 10

build_sparql.question: Who are the frequent authors of The Web Conference?
build_sparql.sparql:
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?name ?affiliation (COUNT(DISTINCT ?publ) as ?freq) (?pers as ?dblp) (SAMPLE(?orcids) as ?orcid) WHERE {
  ?stream rdf:type dblp:Stream .
  ?stream rdfs:label ?stream_label .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(?stream_label, "The Web Conference (WWW)"))
  ?publ dblp:publishedInStream ?stream .
  ?publ dblp:authoredBy ?pers .
  ?pers rdfs:label ?name .
  OPTIONAL { ?pers dblp:primaryAffiliation ?affiliation . }
  OPTIONAL { ?pers dblp:orcid ?orcids . }
}
GROUP BY ?name ?affiliation ?pers
ORDER BY DESC(?freq) 
LIMIT 10
